notes.subject: ⟨i stap⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin requires a predicate; Hebrew is verbless 'all in writing'.

notes.subject: עלי השכיל
notes.rationale: 'He made me understand upon me': 'upon me' read as 'with me / toward me' (YHWH instructed David) — JPS instead reads David as giver; the causative favors YHWH as subject.

notes.subject: בכתב מיד יהוה
notes.rationale: The temple plan is transmitted by a written divine communication, revealed knowledge given to David.

translation: Olgeta ⟨i stap⟩ long raitim, i kam long han bilong Yahwe; ⟨em⟩ i skulim mi gutpela long olgeta wok bilong dispela piksa.
